Prediction-NN 研究报告

训练监控、信号质量、交易成本与稳健性评估。
生成日期：2026-08-04

1. Executive Summary

1.0. Integrated Finding

Observed result: the model learned a positive out-of-sample ranking signal, but the selected portfolio construction is not economically viable after costs.
model_assessment
PASS WITH WARNINGS: test timestamp Pearson IC is 0.1042 and retains 91.35% of validation; the model is a useful ranker but explains less than 1% of test target variance.
strategy_assessment
FAIL ECONOMICS: selected top-5% construction earns +59.99 bps/day gross but -16.80 bps/day net because 76.79 bps/day modeled cost exceeds alpha.
data_assessment
PASS WITH WARNINGS: temporal split, manifest status, finite retained arrays, and train-only normalization are sound; only 30.42% of candidate endpoints survive and exact feature-health/checksum coverage is incomplete.

2.3. Cleaning And Sample-Selection Assessment

The materialization is suitable for Fold0 research, but endpoint eligibility is a strong sample-selection mechanism rather than a neutral cleaning step.
metricvalueassessment
train_valid_endpoint_rate0.302740298,966,485 of 987,536,160 candidate endpoints retained
val_valid_endpoint_rate0.30850047,925,108 of 155,348,640 candidate endpoints retained
test_valid_endpoint_rate0.30899747,228,496 of 152,844,480 candidate endpoints retained
overall_valid_endpoint_rate0.304169material sample-selection filter
rejected_history_window_rate0.500000one-hour lookback
rejected_entry_window_rate0.002778entry/session boundary
rejected_exit_window_rate0.083333horizon/session boundary
rejected_entry_vwap_rate0.062032entry VWAP availability
rejected_exit_vwap_rate0.047688exit VWAP availability
Known data risks
risk_1
VWAP-validity filtering favors more active and liquid stocks/times; performance is conditional on this retained universe.
risk_2
fill_value=0.0 can conflate missingness with a genuine zero for fields without an explicit observation-quality mask.
risk_3
The 67-column projection was motivated by a precursor feature-health audit; that audit was not rerun on this exact 2021-2023 materialization.
risk_4
Observed schema hashes are consistent, but required_schema_hash is not pinned and integrity is size-based rather than content-checksum based.

label_se分组 mean_label 的标准误，计算为 label_std / sqrt(row_count)。
label_p05分组内 target 的 5% 分位，用作中间 90% 散点位置阴影下界。
label_p95分组内 target 的 95% 分位，用作中间 90% 散点位置阴影上界。
label_ci90_lowmean_label 的 90% 正态近似置信区间下界，mean_label - 1.64485 * label_se。
label_ci90_highmean_label 的 90% 正态近似置信区间上界，mean_label + 1.64485 * label_se。
row_count分组内有限 prediction/target 样本数。

5.6. Trading Rule And Cost Diagnosis

signal cadence
sample predictions every 60 seconds
selection
equal-weight long top 5% and short bottom 5%; 50% gross exposure per leg
entry
row available at WindowStartMs + 1s; entry 10s later via 10-second VWAP
exit
exit starts 600s after entry and uses a 10-second VWAP
overlap control
10 slot books; each slot recurs after 600 seconds
turnover
0.5 * sum(abs(target_weight - prior_weight))

Execution limitations
limitation_1
The simulator uses continuous AUM-normalized weights and assumes fill_ratio=1; it has no board-lot rounding or order-level fill ledger.
limitation_2
Commission, stamp duty, borrow fees and availability, and cash-equity T+1 constraints are not modeled.
limitation_3
The stock-level short leg is not directly executable for every name in cash equities.
limitation_4
Consequently this is a research portfolio simulation, not a deployment-ready execution backtest.

sliceRobustness slice name; stock1s reports price and volatility.

rank_iccorr(rank(prediction), rank(target)) within the bucket.
hit_rateBucket target > 0 ratio.

字段解释
fieldexplanation
Top-k RobustnessVal/test samples selected by exact DuckDB quantile_cont threshold within each split; train top-k is unavailable for this run.
split样本池名称, 6.6 中为 train 或 test。
selection_methodTop-k selection method; stock1s uses quantile_cont_threshold.
k_pct按 prediction 全局降序选择的样本池顶部百分比。
universe_count该 split 中 finite prediction/target 样本总数。
selected_count该 split,k_pct 下 prediction >= prediction_threshold 的实际入选样本数。
selected_fractionselected_count / universe_count；近似阈值口径下可能略偏离 k_pct / 100。
prediction_thresholdDuckDB approx_quantile(prediction, 1 - k_pct / 100) 得到的近似入选阈值。
mean_label_bps分组内 target 均值, 单位 bps。
median_label_bpsTop-k% 样本 target 近似中位数, 使用 DuckDB approx_quantile(target, 0.5), 单位 bps。
label_std_bpsTop-k% 样本 target 样本标准差, 单位 bps。
hit_rate分组内 target > 0 的比例。
day_count入选样本覆盖的交易日数量。
timestamp_count入选样本覆盖的 date,time 截面数量。

Interpretation Limits
limit_1
Only seed 7 is available for the current GRU384 formal result; seed variance is unknown.
limit_2
No 67-feature group ablation exists, so performance cannot yet be attributed to quote_state, quote_quality, or order_cancel_flow.
limit_3
Fold0 test covers 59 trading days in 2023Q1 only; this is insufficient evidence for Fold1 promotion.
limit_4
One-hour sequences and 10-minute labels overlap heavily, so row-level counts and t-statistics do not represent independent observations.
limit_5
Run metadata has checkpoint and eval-only metric-label inconsistencies; postprocess uses step 194640, but registry fields should be corrected before Fold1.
